verdict.rationale: Vast.ai documents on-demand instance creation from the console search page and from the CLI/REST API. The CLI walkthrough covers search, rent, wait for boot and connect. Docs claim instances spin up in seconds, with cached templates that start quickly, and you can connect via SSH or Jupyter to run code. A keyless probe confirmed the CLI exposes create instance and live offer search. missing for 10: hands-on evidence of actually creating and booting an instance, independent corroboration of time-to-running-code beyond vendor claims.

support.subject: As a developer, I can provision an on-demand GPU instance from the console or API and be running code on it within minutes

citations.quote: The search page is the main portal for finding good machines and creating instances on them.
search for a GPU, rent it, wait for it to boot, connect to it, copy data, and clean up
Spin up GPU instances in seconds at competitive prices.
Despite their large size you'll find they generally start quickly because they have been cached on many of the host machines.
`vastai --help` prints the full command surface including search offers, create instance, and destroy instance.
Connects via SSH, Jupyter, or custom entrypoint
